=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- changelog.d/5609-guard-synced-claude-scripts.md:16 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The contributor note states "The only code change is `GUARD_PATH_PREFIXES = ("hooks/", "scripts/")`; every rule keyed on `is_guard_path` follows." This is inaccurate. The PR also modifies three executable shell `case` patterns in `.github/workflows/update_workflows.yml` (lines 271, 363, 434 — the `guard_source_is_reviewed()` function and two site loops) to add `scripts/*` as a guard classifier. These shell patterns are not keyed on `is_guard_path`; they are independent shell matchers kept in parity with the Python guard set via `tests/test_update_workflows_guardrails.py::test_guard_pattern_matches_claude_twin_sync_guard_paths`.
  WHY: Misleading contributor notes cause future maintainers to underestimate change scope when reviewing similar extensions (a reviewer following the note will not look at `update_workflows.yml`'s shell logic to confirm the parity test still holds). This is the same class of omission flagged by Copilot review comment 4159369932 on this PR. Not a runtime defect, but a documentation accuracy defect that the contributor-facing section should not contain.
- docs/completed/issue-5246-guard-sync-provenance-plan.md:54 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The extension note cites `scripts/claude_twin_sync.py:378` for the deletion diagnostic "guard path deleted; hooks, scripts, and settings are never deleted through a sync, so the repository owner merges this change by hand". The actual return statement is at `scripts/claude_twin_sync.py:384` (the function shifted from line 378 to line 381 in this PR via the docstring comment edit, then the `return` lands three lines below the new function start at 384, not 378 or 386). I verified by reading the file directly: line 384 is the deletion-diagnostic return.
  WHY: A reader following the cited line lands in the function's docstring rather than on the diagnostic itself, defeating the purpose of a sourced extension note. This is the same defect flagged by Copilot review comment 4159370004.
